name: contractgate
description: DataContractGate ingest, ODCS validation, quarantine, and replay. AISchemaGate LLM structured-output validation via egress_validate and violation-fed auto-repair.
long_description: DataContractGate rejects schema-valid but wrong events before they hit a topic: infer a contract, validate ODCS v3.1 and v3.2 imports, dry-run ingest, and inspect or replay quarantine. AISchemaGate uses the same gateway to validate LLM structured output with egress_validate and feed min, max, pattern, enum, and compliance_mode violations into a bounded auto-repair loop.
